items.title: Ricard Alexis Interview, 1959-01-16
items.q: Then the Young Tuxedo band, which Doc Oynos the bass player was the band.

ctx.x: Young Olympia band twice. Then the Young Tuxedo band, which Doc Oynos the bass player was the band. Freddie Babu was the trombone player.
Well I want to ask a little bit about that name, Young Tuxedo.
They worked on the Celestan. Everything Celestan couldn't handle he'd give it to us. You understand?
